messages:
maria_sales: Novaris paused the pilot. Blockers: VPC peering, BYO-KMS compliance, and a pricing/throughput estimate. They need next steps by EOD.

sam_se: I'll own comms. Quick asks: VPC CIDR + infra contact; KMS type (HSM?), and confirmation of throughput target: 8k tokens/sec across 2 streams.

andy_eng: For peering we need CIDR and a test IP. Quick test: `curl -fsS https://vpc-test.redwood.ai/ping` should return `pong`. Sustained 8k tok/s likely needs a 2-GPU Dedicated pilot with prefix caching.

rachel_sec: BYO-KMS OK for Private but we need attestation, list of KMS principals, and rotation policy. I'll send a short security addendum.

jess_legal: I'll draft BYO-KMS addendum and a limited SLA blurb. No latency guarantees until Dedicated is signed.

aaron_ops: We can stand up a 2x GPU pilot in ~48h after SOW + networking. Ballpark cost for ~100M tokens/mo with caching: ~$18k/mo; one-time BYO-KMS integration ~$3k.

infra-bot: Ticket created: PR-8347 (dedicated-pilot/novaris) https://infra.redwood.ai/requests/PR-8347

sam_se: Action items: Maria send customer note with TPS and rollback plan (today EOD); Andy prepare peering checklist (tomorrow AM); Rachel produce security addendum (tomorrow EOD); Jess upload legal redline (today EOD); Aaron confirm invoice flow (tomorrow AM).

maria_sales: Sending updated note to Novaris CTO+infra now. Thanks all :pray:
